status_legend.IMPLEMENTED: Code or documentation exists; consult evidence for exact tested scope. Not whole-product certification.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Only a bounded subset is implemented.
status_legend.EXTERNAL: Requires company operator/provider evidence unavailable here.
status_legend.DESIGNED: Decision/contract direction documented; capability not implemented.
status_legend.BLOCKED: A required release gate could not pass or run.
status_legend.INCOMPLETE: Required source audit/migration work not done.

requirements.decision: A company-first, configurable operational-app foundation; no automatic production certification.
requirements.acceptance: Deliver the complete declared feature and verification scope before v1; no critical open release issues.

requirements.decision: Independent backend/ and frontend/ roots; native FastAPI and static React/optional Node entrypoints; no Docker prerequisite.
requirements.acceptance: Publish both projects on the real PaaS, test authenticated cross-origin routing, restarts and persistent state.

requirements.decision: Application composition injects feature definitions and renderers into a feature-independent kernel.
requirements.acceptance: Architecture checks reject known inverse imports, raw transport, unscoped browser storage and identity adapter bypasses.

requirements.decision: Vendored source template with an explicit managed-core manifest; app-specific code remains outside core ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Test clean generation, independent native publishers, no accidental credential/evidence inheritance; package publication remains optional.

requirements.decision: Three-way hash-based plan with conflict refusal, hash-bound atomic apply, journaled rollback and explicit APP-STOPPED acknowledgement; application-owned schema remains separate.
requirements.acceptance: Maintain the generated-app upgrade fixture through plan, apply, migration, contract regeneration, frontend tests/build, rollback and integrity comparison.

requirements.decision: Typed configuration, injected adapters and custom React renderers; no universal generic database entity.
requirements.acceptance: Prove seven materially named generated applications from public platform APIs without changing platform code; domain-specific behavior remains an explicit qualification layer.

requirements.decision: Strict nonsecret JSON for API origin, title and theme; server-owned configuration and permissions are separate.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown keys, unsafe origins and HTTPS-to-HTTP routing must fail; secrets never enter browser configuration.

requirements.decision: Semantic CSS tokens with operations, clarity and minimal themes; no Tailwind dependency in this review build.
requirements.acceptance: Run real visual/a11y tests, add logo/icon/i18n configuration, remove remaining fixed presentation decisions through named tokens.

requirements.decision: Monitoring behavioral patterns inform shared table, modal, saved-view and dossier ownership; no pixel-parity claim.
requirements.acceptance: Capture approved live SysGrid references by viewport/theme and compare the actual built template.

requirements.decision: Registered workspaces, navigation labels, tenant selection, themes, identity display, bootstrap and error states.
requirements.acceptance: Add remaining configurable shell variants, notification surface and permission-aware multi-feature navigation proof; global scoped search is implemented and tested.

requirements.decision: Pydantic definitions provide fields, columns, filters, sort keys and capabilities; app-owned renderer registry allows custom bodies.
requirements.acceptance: Implement and verify additional table, hybrid, analytical and topology archetypes without coercing domain behavior into CRUD.

requirements.decision: Pydantic/FastAPI owns API and workspace contracts; generate OpenAPI, TypeScript data shapes and operation metadata.
requirements.acceptance: Generation is deterministic and --check fails on drift; qualify generator support before introducing new schema constructs.

requirements.decision: AG Grid Community adapter with selection, column persistence, server pagination, reusable advanced-filter/multi-sort state and local page grouping; Work Items also prove the rich query contract server-side.
requirements.acceptance: Finish grouped/range selection, context menus, visibility UI, utility columns and SysGrid interaction parity; complete full browser/stress proof. Generated routers now decode the shared rich query contract, and Work Items prove explicit and all-matching bulk scopes with server fingerprint/revision revalidation.

requirements.decision: Personal, default-workspace-team and explicit membership-scoped views, exact deep links, schema sanitization, optimistic revisions and server-version conflict reconciliation.
requirements.acceptance: Add true directory-team scopes, favorites/defaults and offline reconciliation; tenant-wide shared is not corporate team membership.

requirements.decision: Definition-driven basic fields, validation, custom field slots, native dialog dirty protection and pending-write disabling.
requirements.acceptance: Verify browser Back/Forward and all navigation paths preserve dirty drafts; add dependent selectors, tabs, async validation and field-level custom constraints.

requirements.decision: Native dialog with nested discard confirmation, focus return and busy lock.
requirements.acceptance: Qualify focus/keyboard behavior in real browsers and add anchored dropdown/context-menu overlay ownership and collision geometry.

requirements.decision: Deep-linked dossiers, structured audit deltas and revision-target reversion for the reference feature.
requirements.acceptance: Add arbitrary two-version comparison, linked-record panels and complex entity dossier slots; run permissions and stale-revert tests.

requirements.decision: Work-item create/update/archive/restore/revert with explicit revision checks and atomic bulk operations.
requirements.acceptance: Do not advertise purge/delete where no endpoint exists; add declared domain-specific lifecycle policies and irreversible-action acceptance.

requirements.decision: Company adapter reads AccessKey only; no browser-supplied username fallback; production requires per-user process evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Two real simultaneous users must get their own username; if one shared process exposes one username, stop rollout and resolve topology.

requirements.decision: Server-owned roles with editable permission sets and CLI membership provisioning; browser flags are never authority.
requirements.acceptance: Complete membership revoke/role-change administration and review object-level policies for new domains; negative tests are mandatory.

requirements.decision: Registry plus UUID-addressed tenant databases, server-checked membership, tenant-scoped API clients and cache keys.
requirements.acceptance: Add tenant disable/recovery management and a separately tested single-database profile; multi-host direct SQLite remains unsupported.

requirements.decision: Synchronous SQLAlchemy and synchronous FastAPI routes for short SQLite operations; domain services and transactions remain explicit.
requirements.acceptance: Keep blocking I/O out of async handlers; introduce async only for a demonstrated adapter need with independent tests.

requirements.decision: Explicit operation IDs, generated typed calls, validation/error envelopes, request IDs, revisions and idempotency for replay-sensitive endpoints.
requirements.acceptance: Add full compatibility checking and typed streaming/file response metadata; generated shapes do not runtime-validate arbitrary JSON.

requirements.decision: TanStack Query with user/tenant/workspace keys; immutable tenant-scoped API client; explicit invalidation; mutations do not auto-retry.
requirements.acceptance: Run actual React integration tests for tenant switches, expired CSRF, network races and cache cancellation.

requirements.decision: Concrete domain tables, constraints, explicit registry/tenant Alembic heads, bounded engine cache, no request-time DDL.
requirements.acceptance: Migrate and restore representative previous schemas; compare lock behavior under documented topology and production-like load.

requirements.decision: Diagnostic probe never grants safety approval. DELETE journal is a conservative supported profile, not a cure for S3 semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Require provider SQLite support plus topology and durability evidence; unsupported object/FUSE mounts remain blocked.

requirements.decision: Trusted same-host utilities reuse identity, permission, transaction and audit services rather than ad-hoc sqlite connections.
requirements.acceptance: Exercise real trusted job/API consumers and enforce filesystem access controls; raw DB access can bypass application authorization.

requirements.decision: Bounded attachments retain atomic metadata/content backup while a tenant-scoped object adapter boundary provides safe atomic local-filesystem and deterministic in-memory storage.
requirements.acceptance: Wire large-file/object references into attachments and add malware/CDR policy before accepting untrusted enterprise documents.

requirements.decision: Explicit migration CLI, quiescent multi-database snapshots, hashes/integrity checks and isolated fresh-root restore.
requirements.acceptance: Perform company restore/redeploy drill, define RPO/RTO and encrypted off-host retention; APP-STOPPED token is operator acknowledgement, not a distributed lock.

requirements.decision: Versioned CSV/XLSX/JSON snapshots, reversible formula escaping, bounded preview, fingerprint review and atomic import.
requirements.acceptance: Add relationship-aware multi-entity snapshots, background imports and export audit policy where required.

requirements.decision: Typed tenant-scoped adapter executor with provider allowlists, secret handles, timeout/retry/idempotency/rate-limit rules and redacted results.
requirements.acceptance: Add a durable production secret resolver and a company-approved provider contract; deterministic adapter tests are local proof.

requirements.decision: Separate native worker publication when required; durable jobs, leases and fencing must match supported database semantics.
requirements.acceptance: Choose and prove company-compatible job execution; no fake timer loop advertised as durable scheduling.

requirements.decision: Optional authenticated tenant-scoped event transport; default baseline uses query refresh rather than global broadcasts.
requirements.acceptance: Implement authorization on connect and each subscription, replay/reconnect policy and multi-instance delivery tests.

requirements.decision: Actor/tenant/request-correlated changes written transactionally; SQLite triggers reject update/delete of audit rows.
requirements.acceptance: Define retention, export logging and tamper-evident external evidence; database owners can alter schema, so this is not WORM storage.

requirements.decision: Safe API error envelope, request IDs, bounded client response diagnostics, explicit configuration/bootstrap failures.
requirements.acceptance: Test failure kinds and prevent secrets in responses; full SysGrid support-bundle UX remains outside this implementation.

requirements.decision: Request admission/logging, correlation IDs, health/readiness and safe diagnostics.
requirements.acceptance: Add operational metrics, latency histograms, traces, alerts and target PaaS log collection; configure service-level objectives.

requirements.decision: Fail-closed production profile, server identity/membership, CSRF, explicit origins/hosts, bounded input, path constraints and revisions.
requirements.acceptance: Independent threat review and penetration tests; resolve actual identity/storage assumptions; no claim of ASVS conformance.

requirements.decision: Exact backend dependency snapshot and candidate frontend pins; CI requires locks and high-severity advisory gates.
requirements.acceptance: Resolve/review frontend lock, install/scan dependencies, add hash-locked Python artifacts, SBOM/provenance and licensing review.

requirements.decision: Native semantics, labels, keyboard/dialog source and Playwright axe test definitions exist.
requirements.acceptance: Run the built app plus manual keyboard/screen-reader/zoom testing; zero serious/critical axe findings alone does not certify WCAG.

requirements.decision: Bounded 50-row UI pages, 100-row bulk/import, 1 MB attachments and short serialized SQLite writes.
requirements.acceptance: Measure production-like bundle size, p95 latency, render responsiveness and memory under expected load; no benchmark claims from design limits.

requirements.decision: Desktop-first responsive CSS and Chromium test harness; browser support matrix is proposed, not certified.
requirements.acceptance: Qualify company-managed browser/version, Windows/macOS modifiers, 200% zoom and mobile layouts where required.

requirements.decision: UTC serialization and Unicode validation; labels in app/feature definitions, English reference UI.
requirements.acceptance: Centralize UI date/number formatting and localization catalogs; define display timezone and DST behavior.

requirements.decision: Tenant-scoped durable in-app notifications with read/dismiss, mark-all-read and revision-safe per-kind preferences; external delivery remains adapter-driven.
requirements.acceptance: Add accessible announcement timing/dismissal and optional provider-backed durable notifications with preferences.

requirements.decision: Workspace metadata and server permission registry; visible capabilities must not replace backend enforcement.
requirements.acceptance: Add typed runtime flag policy and validate capabilities against installed handlers to prevent advertised but missing features.

requirements.decision: One dev entrypoint: setup/start/seed/contracts/architecture/verify/create/upgrade-plan/operator.
requirements.acceptance: Commands use explicit data roots, refuse destructive implicit resets and report missing prerequisites as blocked.

requirements.decision: Explicit localhost profile, isolated smoke/E2E data and separate production env examples.
requirements.acceptance: Qualify forwarded company dev origins and platform publisher behavior; do not copy development identity into production.

requirements.decision: Executed backend/tooling/client/static-server/HTTP checks; React/Playwright tests authored but not executed here.
requirements.acceptance: Run complete clean-install UI/API/security/browser suites plus company recovery and performance tests.

requirements.decision: Revision, CSV, authorization, storage, API and source-boundary tests protect several repeated failure classes.
requirements.acceptance: Add full SysGrid grid/overlay/lifecycle behavior suite and AST-based frontend rules; string checks are not exhaustive.

requirements.decision: Single command records exact commands, logs, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and separates code readiness from deployment certification.
requirements.acceptance: Clean installation passes every code gate; any missing lock/tool is blocked, never quietly skipped.

requirements.decision: Pinned-action CI executes backend/tools and exact frontend root with required lock and browser/security jobs.
requirements.acceptance: Run real PR CI, configure protected branches and artifact attestations; no remote workflow was executed in this delivery.

requirements.decision: FastAPI app.main:app plus optional run.py; React dist or native Node server.mjs; explicit runtime JSON.
requirements.acceptance: Verify actual PaaS starting-file/root/runtime conventions, domains and persistence before publication.

requirements.decision: Local repository instructions identify editing boundaries, proofs and no automatic destructive operations.
requirements.acceptance: New agent follows the repository without claiming unrun tests; do not overwrite SysGrid control-room policy.

requirements.decision: Small feature modules, local recipes, generated types and limited platform ownership.
requirements.acceptance: Observe real agent implementation tasks and context use; do not claim token savings without measurement.

requirements.decision: Python AST and targeted TypeScript source checks enforce known dependency/identity/transport/storage constraints.
requirements.acceptance: Add full TypeScript AST rules and exception policy; test deliberate bypass attempts and false positives.

requirements.decision: Fresh application generator with configuration overrides, no source mutation and managed-core hashes.
requirements.acceptance: Add feature/workspace/schema/migration generators only after second-domain patterns are validated.

requirements.decision: Local startup, customization, security, deployment, recovery, architecture decisions, recipes, evidence and scope ledger.
requirements.acceptance: Keep commands executable and add automated documentation-link/recipe tests as tooling matures.

requirements.decision: Real work-items backend and React source with CRUD, revisions, saved views, history, bulk, CSV and attachments.
requirements.acceptance: Build and browse the feature; complete grouping/context/compare parity and permission-lifecycle UX acceptance.

requirements.decision: Three generated theme configurations retain identical core hashes.
requirements.acceptance: Implement a second domain and materially different shell; theme switches alone are not proof of radical product customizability.

requirements.decision: Pinned branch/tree and selected high-value contracts were read; retained mapping records exactly this scope.
requirements.acceptance: Inventory and inspect every relevant source/test/guard with hashes and evidence; do not label a sampled review exhaustive.

requirements.decision: Monitoring common patterns are recorded from source; no live screenshots or whole-product behavior catalogue.
requirements.acceptance: Capture routed UX and tests against the pinned source for all target domains, including recent Project changes.

requirements.decision: No changes were made to SysGrid; staged compatibility plan is documented.
requirements.acceptance: Migrate one real domain behind a switch, prove parity, then two distinct domains before declaring generality.

requirements.decision: New core avoids giant modules, dual API types, global CSS overrides and root-package CI confusion.
requirements.acceptance: This does not repair current SysGrid in place; test actual migration and code ownership changes independently.

requirements.decision: Ignore data/secrets/caches; tracked examples only; reviewed source/evidence separated.
requirements.acceptance: Add clean-checkout scans, owner-selected licensing and codeowners/protected branches in the target repository.

requirements.decision: Promote only proven repeated behavior; application quirks remain in features; version breaking public contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Assign maintainers and perform one reviewed upgrade/contribution cycle.

requirements.decision: Review build is NOT_CERTIFIED; local evidence never authorizes company deployment.
requirements.acceptance: Close scope gaps, code gates and company evidence; independent approval tied to exact artifact digest.

requirements.decision: Identity/database/storage/deployment can be replaced at composition boundaries; no home profile implementation bundled.
requirements.acceptance: Implement and test OIDC/PostgreSQL/object storage only after company core proves itself; do not assume database dialect portability.

requirements.decision: Measure accepted-feature effort, context/usage, changed core files, regressions, build time and upgrade conflicts.
requirements.acceptance: Run comparable real tasks and publish observed results, not invented productivity percentages.

requirements.decision: Key choices, alternatives, limitations and proof obligations are retained.
requirements.acceptance: Keep decisions current when adapters, infrastructure or public contracts change.

continuation_note: Native Experience Lab adds 23 provisional interactive families. Original 68-domain statuses are not automatically promoted; expanded scope is tracked in catalog/roadmap.json.
